name: Table
description: Represents a table shape on a slide. The Table object is a member of the Shapes collection. The Table object contains the Columns collection and the Rows collection.
example:
With ActivePresentation.Slides(2).Shapes

    For i = 1 To .Count

        If .Item(i).HasTable Then

            .Item(i).ActionSettings(ppMouseClick) _

                .Action = ppActionNextSlide

        End If

    Next

End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Columns
properties.description: Returns a Columns collection that represents all the columns in a table. Read-only.

properties.name: Rows
properties.description: Returns a Rows collection that represents all the rows in a table. Read-only.

properties.name: TableDirection
properties.description: Returns or sets the direction in which the table cells are ordered. Read/write.

properties.name: FirstRow
properties.description: Determine whether to display special formatting for the first row of the specified table. Read/write.

properties.name: LastRow
properties.description: Determines whether to display special formatting for the last row of the specified table. Read/write.

properties.name: FirstCol
properties.description: Determines whether to display special formatting for the first column of the specified table. Read/write.

properties.name: LastCol
properties.description: Determines whether to display special formatting for the last column of the specified table. Read/write.

properties.name: HorizBanding
properties.description: Determines whether to display banded rows, in which even rows are formatted differently from odd rows. Read/write.

properties.name: VertBanding
properties.description: Determines whether to display banded columns, in which even columns are formatted differently from odd columns. Read/write.

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Returns a TableStyle object that contains information about the specified table's current table style. Read-only.

properties.name: Background
properties.description: Returns the TableBackground object associated with the specified table. Read-only.

properties.name: AlternativeText
properties.description: Returns or sets the alternative text associated with a shape in a Web presentation. Read/write.

properties.name: Title
properties.description: Returns or sets the title of the Table object. Read/write.

methods.name: Cell
methods.signature: Cell(Row As Long, Column As Long) As Cell
methods.description: Returns a Cell object that represents a cell in a table.

parameters.name: Row
parameters.description: The number of the row in the table to return. Can be an integer between 1 and the number of rows in the table.

parameters.name: Column
parameters.description: The number of the column in the table to return. Can be an integer between 1 and the number of columns in the table.

methods.name: ScaleProportionally
methods.description: Scales all cell heights and widths, font sizes, and internal margins in the table by a specified proportion.

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: The proportion to scale the table, between 0.01 and 100. For example, a scale value of 1 keeps the table layout unchanged; a value of 2 makes it twice as large; a value of 0.5 makes it half the size.

methods.name: ApplyStyle
methods.description: Applies a table style to the specified table.

parameters.name: StyleID
parameters.description: The identifier of the table style to apply.
